column3: BSB follows the Textus Receptus with “testimony”; the critical text has “mystery” (μυστήριον).
Spirit and power are combined as “the Spirit’s power.”
Before the ages is rendered as “before time began.”
Coming up on a human heart is rendered as imagining.
“Thoughts” specifies the things of humans and of God.
Not being judged is rendered as not being subject to judgment.
